head: 22e2fb772f69ec1f5e32e3a8d314ab3ffb63d3cd
finding: The retained-state test compares inode and bytes for the active process receipt, while the live runner atomically replaces that receipt on each tracker pass. Healthy publication can therefore fail the public lease rejection invariance test.
required_boundary: Keep protected-file invariance; validate the one exact current process receipt as an evolving same-run snapshot rather than fixed pathname inode. No broad ignore, ownership/lifecycle/protocol weakening or failed-campaign replay.
